caption: The drawing depicts a carefully rendered garment consisting of a short-sleeved shirt or blouse laid flat above a folded rectangular cloth. The shirt has a wide, rounded neckline adorned with floral embroidery that extends around the neck and down the front placket, which has two small buttons. The sleeves are short and wide, ending in cuffs detailed with matching embroidery. The shirt appears to be made of a light, off-white or beige fabric, with subtle shading used to indicate folds, creases, and volume. Beneath the shirt, a similarly colored piece of fabric is visible, folded neatly at the bottom edge and extending slightly beyond the sides of the shirt. The entire composition is set against a plain, light background, and there is a faint signature in the lower right corner with the name "Eugene Croe."
title: Chemise
